constraints: Source revision is not deployable artifact identity.
Mutable image tag or alias is not immutable deployment identity.
QA strategy success is not equivalent to QualityAcceptance ACCEPT.
A caller-selected subset of component refs cannot prove acceptance completeness.
Deployment change during the QA verification window cannot produce current acceptance for the newer release.
DevOps and Product QA remain separate authority domains for deployment publication and quality judgment.

architectureDecisions: DeployableArtifactRef is immutable/content-addressed and binds component kind plus exact artifact digest; BuildProvenance binds that deployable to one accepted source-delivery/publication ref. Branch, source commit and mutable image tag are metadata only and never correctness identity.

BB-054 researches against BB-053's READY plan but WORKER execution remains dependency-gated. After BB-053 is DONE, DevOps/QA consume delivered DomainExecutionInput, domain activation and FE/BE publication truth; the BB-053 plan itself never becomes runtime authority.

DevOps executes through the existing DomainExecutionController boundary using a DEVOPS WorkContract/DomainExecutionInput and a domain-local devops execution strategy. Strategy success produces deployment evidence only; it cannot issue QualityAcceptance.

DeploymentRelease is an immutable DevOps publication created only from an accepted DevOps DomainCompletionDecision/DomainPublicationReceipt plus exact FE/BE DeployableArtifactRefs, environmentRef, correctness-relevant config refs and rollout/health evidence.

DeploymentReleaseHead(environmentRef) is a CAS-headed current pointer. Its store exposes an exact current-release guard shared with DevOps release publication; Product QA may hold that guard for currentness validation but cannot mutate the release head.

AcceptanceSnapshot is content-addressed and built deterministically from one exact current DeploymentRelease plus one acceptance policy. The builder derives mandatory FE/BE component refs, criteria refs, environment and verifier policy; callers cannot provide or omit the component set.

RuntimeObservationEvidence is produced through an independently configured observer adapter and pins observer identity/policy, environment, component, expected deployable digest and the observed runtime identity set. Deployment/app self-report is not runtime observation.

Mixed, unknown or mismatched observed runtime identity is BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE by default. An explicit acceptance policy may define a bounded allowed set, but cannot replace the exact snapshot or silently substitute release components.

Product QA execution is bound to one AcceptanceSnapshot. It checks release currentness before dispatch, observes runtime independently, and emits criterion/runtime evidence; QA strategy SUCCEEDED remains factual execution state only.

QualityAcceptance is created by a separate Product QA acceptance publisher only after an ACCEPT DomainCompletionDecision and accepted QA DomainPublicationReceipt. Final publication executes while holding the exact DeploymentReleaseHead guard pinned by the snapshot, so a release change during QA cannot become current acceptance.

DeploymentRelease, AcceptanceSnapshot, RuntimeObservationEvidence and QualityAcceptance are immutable historical artifacts. Current heads may advance, but historical evidence remains fresh-session resolvable by exact refs.
implementationSlices: EF1 — Exact deployable provenance [AC-1, AC-7, INV-1, INV-2]: add deployable-artifact.js with immutable BuildProvenance and DeployableArtifactRef. Require componentKind FRONTEND|BACKEND, accepted sourceDeliveryRef, artifactDigest and build evidence; tag/branch/source commit may be metadata but never substitute for artifactDigest. Verify deployable-provenance + deployment-provenance-chain.

EF2 — DevOps release publication/currentness [AC-1, AC-5, AC-6, INV-8]: add devops-execution-strategy.js and deployment-release.js. DEVOPS execution consumes exact FE/BE DeployableArtifactRefs through the delivered BB-053 DomainExecutionInput path. After accepted domain completion/publication, create one immutable DeploymentRelease and CAS-advance DeploymentReleaseHead(environmentRef). Share one environment-specific mutation guard between head advancement and QA final-currentness validation. Verify deployment-release + domain-execution-regression.

EF3 — Deterministic AcceptanceSnapshot [AC-2, AC-6, INV-6]: add acceptance-snapshot.js. Builder reads exact current DeploymentRelease + acceptance policy, derives the mandatory FRONTEND/BACKEND component set and pins release ref/head revision, environment, criteria and verifier policy. No caller component/ref list is accepted. Verify acceptance-snapshot.

EF4 — Independent runtime observation [AC-3, AC-4, INV-3]: add runtime-observation.js. Observer adapter is configured independently from DevOps/application publication, emits immutable RuntimeObservationEvidence for every snapshot component, and reports observed runtime identity sets. Missing/unknown/mixed/mismatched identities fail closed unless the pinned policy explicitly permits a bounded set. Verify runtime-observation.

EF5 — Product QA execution/acceptance separation [AC-3, AC-4, AC-7, INV-4, INV-5, INV-8]: add product-qa.js. QA execution consumes one immutable AcceptanceSnapshot, performs pre-dispatch release-currentness check, invokes independent observation + criterion verification, and returns evidence only. A separate acceptance publisher requires QA DomainCompletionDecision ACCEPT + DomainPublicationReceipt before creating QualityAcceptance. Verify product-qa + project-acceptance-regression + domain-execution-regression.

EF6 — Deployment-change race fence [AC-5, INV-7]: product-qa final publication reacquires DeploymentReleaseHead(environmentRef) through the exact guard pinned by AcceptanceSnapshot and holds it through QualityAcceptance current-head CAS. If the release changed before lock acquisition the publish fails; DevOps cannot advance that head while the final acceptance commit is inside the guard. Verify barrier-controlled product-qa-race.

EF7 — Fresh-session provenance chain [AC-6, AC-7]: persist all BB-054 artifacts through existing immutable/CAS store primitives and expose exact resolvers/exports. A fresh process reconstructs SourceDelivery/DomainPublication -> BuildProvenance -> DeployableArtifactRef -> DeploymentRelease -> AcceptanceSnapshot -> RuntimeObservationEvidence -> QualityAcceptance without conversation state. Verify deployment-provenance-chain + agentic-regression.
